blind_spots_patched: Baseline ch01..ch06 completely omitted the 2025–2026 U.S. tariff shock on Indian polished diamonds and LGD exports (up to 50% in 2025, transitioning to a 10% Section 301 duty effective July 24, 2026) and its second-order impact on Surat polishers, export rerouting via Dubai, and IGIL's U.S./Belgium labs.

Baseline ch-4 omitted AI-assisted grading challenger GCAL by Sarine, its >50% H1 2026 grading growth, and its August–September 2026 launch of a dedicated jewelry certification lab inside Mumbai's SEEPZ export zone alongside its Surat lab.

Baseline ch-1 and ch-5 omitted Note 47 ESOP 2024 vesting mechanics (60% tethered to Blackstone sponsor tranche realization across 19.55M options / 4.52% dilution), the full ~92% sponsor-monetization substance of the IPO plus ₹246.1 Cr FY26 sponsor dividends, the May 2026 corporate rename, and the September 7, 2026 100% consolidation of IGI Botswana.

Baseline ch-5 and ch-6 omitted India standalone EBITDA margin compression (-340 bps YoY to 69.5% in Q2 FY27), the FY26 Ind AS 109 ECL allowance cut (7.39% to 1.82%), ₹2,307.3M combined post-AGL goodwill/intangibles and ₹891.8M capex commitments, 11 unreviewed subsidiaries in Q2 FY27 limited review, and formal legal/contingent liability verification.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Blackstone holds a stable 76.55% stake ahead of the December 2027 SEBI MPS deadline, and the December 2024 IPO and global roll-up unified IGI cleanly with minimal governance friction.

WEAKENED: GIA's October 1, 2025 shift from 4Cs letter grades to broad Premium/Standard tiers for lab-grown diamonds cemented IGI's ~65% LGD standard with only SGL, GSI, and HRD Antwerp as secondary rivals.

CONFIRMED: LGD loose (+37% YoY) and studded jewelry (+47% YoY) volume growth plus AGL colored-stone integration are lifting consolidated margins (+340 bps YoY to 61.4%) while preserving uniform operating leverage.
WEAKENED: Multi-year financial forensics show zero accounting red flags beyond rising debtor days (47 to 66 days) partially reversed by Q2 FY27's ₹662M receivables release.
